verified_observations.claim: The structured renderer tolerates partial nodes and unknown fields.
If root_nodes are unusable, the UI degrades to a flat node list.
Restart-context derivation consumes this artifact and records provenance plus warnings.

soft_contract_points: The read model requires session_id, nodes[], and root_nodes[] but does not validate node internals beyond best-effort normalization.
The semantic meaning of node status values is inferred ad hoc in the UI.
Parent-child consistency is not validated as part of artifact loading.
overfitting_signals: The implementation assumes node_id, parent, children, evidence, and root_nodes naming.
Restart-context derivation assumes unresolved nodes are any status other than resolved or complete.
visible_gap: Graph/read-model mismatch produces inline fallback, but not research-track telemetry.
next_step: Split strict envelope validation from tolerant graph payload interpretation and move graph read-model utilities out of component-layer code.
